meta.title: GHG Scope 3: Employee Commuting Dashboard
meta.privacy: Name, email, detailed affiliation and exact building/floor fields were removed before publishing.
meta.methodNote: Adjusted GHG is recalculated from ADJ. (SCALE UP) FUEL CONSUMPTION PER YEAR × EF_FACTOR ÷ 1000 instead of summing the rounded Adjusted GHG column. Walking is 0 tCO2e. BTS/MRT rows without an emission factor remain excluded.
meta.calculationLogic: Adjusted GHG = ADJ. (SCALE UP) FUEL CONSUMPTION PER YEAR × EF_FACTOR ÷ 1000
